newsitem.title: INDIA: India shares piggyback on Bajaj Auto bonus news.
newsitem.headline: India shares piggyback on Bajaj Auto bonus news.

text.p: ** (1330 GMT) Indian blue chips rebound to close up on
announcement of bonus issue by scooter-giant Bajaj Auto
which ends eight percent higher at 915.25
** Bajaj to meet for bonus issue on Monday; chief says not
in favour of the firm issuing one-for-one bonus
** Bombay share index up 88.33 pts from 3,652.20--day's low
ends 38.57 pts, 1.04 pct higher over Tuesday's close
** Buying seen at lower levels, but worries about possible
hike in government-controlled oil prices remain
** Thermax posts four pct fall in 1996/97 net profit, stock
